item.title: Yubari Melon — Guide
item.description: The Yubari melon (Yubari King) is Hokkaido’s most famous fruit and one of Japan’s ultimate luxury foods, grown in the former coal-mining town of Yubari in central Hokkaido. A premium cantaloupe-type melon with beautifully netted skin and vivid orange flesh, it’s prized for its intense sweetness, juicy tenderness and rich aroma, the result of careful cultivation in Yubari’s ideal soil and climate. Yubari melons are graded by strict standards, and the finest specimens are legendary for fetching astonishing prices at the season’s first auctions — the top pairs have sold for millions of yen, making headlines each year.
